item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"The harness uses `dspy.ChatAdapter().format_system_message(...)` to render the comparison prompts directly from signatures for offline inspection, rather than invoking an LM call.","span_ids":["s5"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"One comparison prompt is built from a signature whose output field is `dspy.Code`, and that rendered system message includes `dspy.Code.description()`'s markdown code block instruction.","span_ids":["s3","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"The `dspy.Code` system message is checked to exclude the generic JSON-schema guidance and dumped schema text, matching the special-case in `translate_field_type` that suppresses schema notes for `Code` outputs.","span_ids":["s2","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The non-Code structured comparison prompt exercises the ordinary structured-output path and is checked to include the generic `must adhere to the JSON schema` guidance with inline schema JSON.","span_ids":["s2","s5","s6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/adapters/utils.py","start_line":93,"end_line":118},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/adapters/types/code.py","start_line":78,"end_line":84},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/adapters/test_chat_adapter.py","start_line":402,"end_line":416},{"span_id":"s5","path":"tests/adapters/test_chat_adapter.py","start_line":716,"end_line":745},{"span_id":"s6","path":"tests/adapters/test_chat_adapter.py","start_line":419,"end_line":431}]}
